name: Van Helsing's Club
description: Movie Park Germany's most atmospheric dining experience — a beautifully themed restaurant located directly within the Van Helsing factory area, serving hearty German and international dishes in a dramatic steampunk-gothic setting filled with vampire hunter props, dark wood furnishings and atmospheric lighting. Van Helsing's Club is the finest sit-down dining option in the park and the most immersive restaurant atmosphere of any attraction at Movie Park Germany. Perfect for a proper lunch between the major rides.

items.name: Schnitzel mit Pommes
items.description: Classic breaded Wiener Schnitzel with potato salad and fries

items.description: Large beef burger with dark bun, bacon and blood orange sauce

name: Hollywood Snacks
description: The park's main fast food hub located in the Hollywood Street area near the entrance — serving a wide selection of burgers, chicken, hot dogs, fries and soft drinks in a classic Hollywood diner-inspired setting. Hollywood Snacks is the most accessible and centrally located food option for guests wanting a quick, satisfying meal without committing to a sit-down restaurant. The outdoor seating area has views of the main park boulevard.

items.name: Hollywood Burger
items.description: Classic beef burger with all toppings and fries

items.description: Grilled chicken in a warm tortilla with salad and sauce

items.description: Tortilla chips with cheese sauce and salsa

items.name: Milkshake
items.description: Thick Hollywood-style milkshake in various flavours

name: Pizza Depot
description: A reliable and popular pizza restaurant near the Old West area serving freshly baked individual and sharing pizzas with classic toppings alongside pasta dishes and salads. Pizza Depot is one of the best value food options at Movie Park Germany — the portions are generous and the quality is consistently good compared to typical theme park dining. The indoor and outdoor seating makes it a pleasant lunch spot whatever the weather.

name: Spirello
description: Movie Park Germany's most popular sweet snack stop — Spirello serves spiral-cut potato snacks, churros, crepes, ice cream and a variety of sweet and savoury handheld treats that are perfect for eating while walking between attractions. Located near the centre of the park, Spirello is the go-to stop for an afternoon treat and consistently has some of the shortest wait times of any food outlet in the park.
